description: 19 trees: T8; T9; T12; T15; T30; T48; T53; T63; T74; T75; T76; T77; T78; T85; T87; T89; T91; T94; and T100.T8 - Quercus palustris (Pin oak); Prune to clear lamp column/CCTV head by 1 m.T9 - Liquidambar styraciflua (Sweet gum); Remove deadwood.T12 - Liquidambar styraciflua (Sweet gum); Remove deadwood.T15 - Quercus robur (English oak); Prune to clear lamp column/CCTV head by 1 m.T30 - Liquidambar styraciflua (Sweet gum); Crown lift over the footway to 2.5 m, removing branches under 5 cm diameter.T48 - Taxodium distichum (Swamp cypress); Remove lower, suppressed, dead limbs to a height of 3.5 m and up to 3 cm diameter.T53 - Taxodium distichum (Swamp cypress); Prune to clear lamp column/CCTV head by 1 m.T63 - Platanus × hispanica (London plane); Remove lower, suppressed, dead limbs to a height of 4 m and up to 3 cm diameter.T74 - Taxodium distichum (Swamp cypress); Crown lift small branches to clear the adjacent hedge by 0.5 m.T75 - Taxodium distichum (Swamp cypress); Crown lift small branches to clear the adjacent hedge by 0.5 m.T76 - Taxodium distichum (Swamp cypress); Prune to clear lamp column/CCTV head by 1 m.T77 - Tilia cordata (Small-leaved lime); Remove single low limb on the northern side, at 2.5 m height and 3 cm diameter.T78 - Taxodium distichum (Swamp cypress); Crown lift small branches to clear the adjacent hedge by 0.5 m.T85 - Taxodium distichum (Swamp cypress); Crown lift to 2.5 m over the playground and path.T87 - Liquidambar styraciflua (Sweet gum); Prune to clear lamp column/CCTV head by 1 m.T89 - Fagus sylvatica (Common beech); Prune to clear lamp column/CCTV head by 1 m.T91 - Quercus robur (English oak); Crown lift to 2.5 m over the playground.T94 - Taxodium distichum (Swamp cypress); Crown lift small branches to clear the adjacent hedge by 0.5 m.T100 - Liquidambar styraciflua (Sweet gum); Crown lift small branches to clear the adjacent hedge by 0.5 m.
